description: This file contains multiple internal class definitions for Orleans grains used in unit testing scenarios. It includes implementations of activation/deactivation lifecycle methods, exception handling for erroneous grains, and complex asynchronous behaviors to test Orleans grain lifecycle and concurrency management.

classes.name: SimpleActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Implements basic activation/deactivation logic with assertions and external watcher calls for testing Orleans grain lifecycle.

classes.name: TailCallActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Uses continuation tasks to handle activate/deactivate lifecycle with asynchronous assertions, testing tail call behavior.

classes.name: LongRunningActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Simulates a long-running activation involving thread sleeps and thread pool task spawning to test mode resilience.

classes.name: TaskActionActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Performs activation and deactivation using complex task chains, continuation tasks, async lambdas, and thread assertions to test concurrency and scheduler behavior.

classes.name: BadActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Deliberately throws exceptions during lifecycle methods to test error handling.

classes.name: BadConstructorTestGrain
classes.description: Constructor throws exception to test grain creation failure handling.

classes.name: DeactivatingWhileActivatingTestGrain
classes.description: Calls DeactivateOnIdle during activation to test handling of deactivation during startup.

classes.name: CreateGrainReferenceTestGrain
classes.description: Creates and interacts with references to other grains, performing method calls and ensuring data consistency.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, often with logging, assertions, and calls to external watcher grains.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, with logging, assertions, and external watcher notifications.

methods.name: DoSomething
methods.description: Returns a string identifier, often used as a test verification method.

methods.name: ThrowSomething
methods.description: Intentionally throws an exception to test error handling.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns grain key, with exception thrown in error scenarios.

methods.name: DeactivatingWhileActivatingTestGrain
methods.description: Calls DeactivateOnIdle during activation to simulate deactivation during startup.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync (with thread sleep and task spawn)
methods.description: Simulates long activation process with subtask and thread sleep to test concurrent activation handling.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync (with thread sleep)
methods.description: Performs deactivation with thread sleep to simulate long deactivation process.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync (with chained continuation tasks)
methods.description: Uses chained tasks and async lambdas to test asynchronous activation sequences.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync (with continuation tasks)
methods.description: Uses continuation tasks to handle deactivation asynchronously.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync (with Task.Factory.StartNew and async continuation)
methods.description: Performs complex task orchestration for activation to test scheduler behavior.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync (with task chains and sleeping)
methods.description: Handles deactivation with asynchronous task chains and sleeping to test concurrency.
